exam_name: Mid Term Exam 2 (Internal Assessment) - Operating Systems

standard_paper_format.choice_pattern: Every question has an internal OR choice (e.g. Q1.A or Q1.B).

option_A.topic: Preemptive CPU Scheduling (SRTF or Round Robin) Numerical
option_A.recommendation: ALWAYS_ATTEMPT (Numerical yields 10/10 if Gantt chart is correct)

option_B.topic: Multilevel Queue Scheduling & Thread Scheduling Theory

option_A.topic: Producer-Consumer Problem using Counting Semaphores (Standard Code)

option_B.topic: Dining Philosophers Problem using Monitors / Peterson's Algorithm Proof
option_B.recommendation: SAFELY_SKIP (High chance of syntax or condition error)

option_A.topic: Banker's Algorithm Safety & Request Sequence Numerical
option_A.recommendation: ALWAYS_ATTEMPT (Pure matrix subtraction: Need = Max - Allocation)

option_B.topic: Deadlock Detection Algorithm for Multiple Instances & Recovery Schemes
option_B.recommendation: SAFELY_SKIP (Too much writing for same 10 marks)

option_A.topic: Paging Hardware Architecture + TLB Numerical (Effective Access Time)

option_B.topic: Segmentation with Paging / Internal vs External Fragmentation Theory

question_pattern_intelligence.structure: Answer any 2 out of 4 (5 marks each)

high_frequency_short_topics.topic: Critical Section 3 Requirements (Mutual Exclusion, Progress, Bounded Wait)
